title: GDExtension's dependency DLLs cannot be found even though the folder path is added to PATH in the environment variables
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible: 4.2.2-stable, 4.4-stable (other versions are not tested)

### System information

Win11-Godot 4.2.2-stable-visual studio 2022-Vulkan-Nvidia RTX4070Ti

### Issue description

My gdextension dll file has some dependency thirdparty dlls (opencv). The folder containing the dlls has already beed added to PATH in the environment variable. But I always have the error "Error: Error 126: The specified module could not be found..". But if I copy all dependency dlls to the `project/bin` folder, which is the same as the gdextension dll file, the project works.

I found the code how the engine searches for the dll loading path in os_windows.cpp.
```
p_library_handle = (void *)LoadLibraryExW((LPCWSTR)(path.utf16().get_data()), nullptr, (p_also_set_library_path && has_dll_directory_api) ? LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS : 0);
```
It seems to include all folder paths in PATH environment variable, but I don't know why it fails. If I manually add the dll folder path, it works ( without copying the dlls to the `project/bin` fodler)
```
String opencv_dll_folder = "D:/code/3rd/bins";
cookie_gstreamer_folder = add_dll_directory((LPCWSTR)(opencv_dll_folder .utf16().get_data()));
```


### Steps to reproduce

1. Download opencv lib [opencv-4.10.0-windows.exe](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/releases/download/4.10.0/opencv-4.10.0-windows.exe) from github
2. Install the opencv library. (example, D:/code/3rd/OpenCV/)
3. Add the bin path (D:/code/3rd/OpenCV/x64/vc17/bin) to system environment PATH
4. Test with the godot-cpp project
- Add opencv library in godot-cpp/test/SConstruct
```
# Path to OpenCV headers (change this according to your OpenCV installation)
# Replace with your actual OpenCV installation path
opencv_include_path = "D:/code/3rd/OpenCV/include"
# Path to OpenCV libraries (change this according to your OpenCV installation)
opencv_lib_path = "D:/code/3rd/OpenCV/x64/vc17/lib" # Adjust the path based on your OpenCV version and Visual Studio version
# Add OpenCV include path
env.Append(CPPPATH=[opencv_include_path])
# Add OpenCV library path
env.Append(LIBPATH=[opencv_lib_path])
# Specify versioned OpenCV libraries (e.g., opencv_core4100.lib)
# List the OpenCV libraries with the version suffix
env.Append(LIBS=[
"opencv_core4100", # Replace with the actual version of OpenCV core
"opencv_imgproc4100", # Replace with the actual version of OpenCV imgproc
"opencv_highgui4100", # Replace with the actual version of OpenCV highgui
"opencv_imgcodecs4100", # Replace with the actual version of OpenCV
])
```
- Add opencv header file in godot-cpp/test/src/example.h (line 33)
```

#include <godot_cpp/core/binder_common.hpp>
#include <godot_cpp/core/gdvirtual.gen.inc>

using namespace godot;

#include <opencv2/highgui/highgui.hpp>
#include <opencv2/opencv.hpp>

class ExampleRef : public RefCounted {
	GDCLASS(ExampleRef, RefCounted);
```
- Add opencv header file in godot-cpp/test/src/example.cpp (line 78)
```
void ExampleRef::_notification(int p_what) {
	if (p_what == NOTIFICATION_POSTINITIALIZE) {
		post_initialized = true;
	}

	cv::Mat img(100, 100, CV_8UC1, cv::Scalar(0));
}
```
- Build and test
